channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Türkiye offers condolences to Hong Kong over deadly fire - Türkiye News
item.description: Türkiye on Thursday extended condolences to Hong Kong as dozens of people were killed in a fire at a residential complex in Tai Po district.

item.title: Flamingos become year-round residents in Van Lake - Türkiye News
item.description: Flamingos that once migrated seasonally between Iran’s Urmia Lake and eastern Türkiye have increasingly become year-round residents in the Van Lake Basin, after the near-total drying of Urmia eliminated one of the region’s key wetlands.

item.title: Edirne to sink city’s miniature underwater to boost diving tourism - Türkiye News
item.description: Authorities in the northwestern province of Edirne are preparing to submerge a stone-built miniature complex of the city in the Saros Gulf as part of efforts to enrich marine life and expand diving tourism.

item.title: Credit growth aligns with disinflation path: Central Bank - Latest News
item.description: Credit growth in Türkiye shows alignment with the disinflation trajectory due to tight monetary conditions, the Central Bank's latest Financial Stability Report stated on Nov. 28.

item.title: Trump vows to ‘permanently pause’ migration from poor nations - World News
item.description: President Donald Trump vowed on Thanksgiving to “permanently pause migration” from poorer nations in a blistering late-night, anti-immigrant screed posted to social media.

item.title: Türkiye, Armenia hold second technical talks on rehabilitating cross-border railway link - Türkiye News
item.description: Türkiye and Armenia on Thursday held the second round of technical talks on the rehabilitation and operationalization of the Kars-Gyumri cross-border railway link, the Turkish Foreign Ministry announced.

item.title: Erdoğan marks progress in public trust for security forces - Türkiye News
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said on Nov. 28 that his government’s more than two-decade rule has “eliminated the grounds for distrust” between the state and citizens.

item.title: Pope Leo marks Christian milestone at historic İznik prayer - Türkiye News
item.description: Pope Leo XIV arrived in Türkiye’s İznik on Nov. 28, joining Orthodox patriarchs at the location of the 325 AD Council of Nicaea to mark the historic event and offer prayers for Christian reunification.

item.title: Türkiye, Germany open new, strategic page in ties - Türkiye News
item.description: Türkiye and Germany have reiterated their common will of opening a new and strategic page in bilateral ties by deepening cooperation in almost all fields, including energy, trade, economy and defense industry.

item.title: Türkiye condemns Israeli strikes on Syrian town near Damascus - Türkiye News
item.description: Türkiye on Friday urged Israel to immediately halt its attacks on the town of Beit Jinn in rural Damascus, saying the strikes violate Syria’s sovereignty and threaten civilians and regional stability.
